gaps.text: Combining several spectroscopy methods (data fusion) (Spectral data from both the Raman and UV-Vis instruments must be collected from equivalent sample locations and synchronized to a common time step. Preprocessing requires block autoscaling to normalize different signal scales, with independent calibration models maintained for each hardware block. Fused regression models must demonstrate a statistically significant accuracy improvement over the best single method on held-out validation batches before justifying two operational instruments.)
Quantitative limits of detection, precision, and accuracy for specific yeast broth metabolites.

Measuring Offline reference metabolite concentrations: Independent chromatographic or enzymatic measurements are required to calibrate and validate in-line Raman models.
